lines.text: Eight guests, eight secrets, one thief. On Christmas Eve, every light in the lodge goes out. When they come back on, the gold star is gone. Each guest gets a character, a secret, and an alibi. Nine clue cards lead to one fair answer. Sixteen pages, and the host can play. Tap the link, and grab it on Etsy.
